title: Spatially Limited Immune Access Creates Tumour Refugia in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
summary: Spatially restricted immune access can undermine tumour control even when total immune recruitment appears sufficient. We develop a nondimensional reaction--diffusion--chemotaxis model for hepatocellular carcinoma that couples tumour growth and immune-mediated killing with effector diffusion, saturating chemokine-dependent recruitment, and migration along an effective CXCL9/CXCL10/CXCL11--CXCR3 signal.
